title: Create a wall schedule with chosen fields, sort it, and read the rows back
task: Produce a schedule view for a category with the columns the user asked for: ViewSchedule.CreateSchedule for OST_Walls, add fields from ScheduleDefinition.GetSchedulableFields by parameter id, sort with ScheduleSortGroupField, then read the body back with GetTableData and GetCellText.

pitfalls.symptom: AddField never finds the parameter, or adds the wrong column.
pitfalls.cause: Fields were matched by display name; names are localised, may repeat (instance vs type), and 'Length' is not the parameter's real identity.
pitfalls.fix: Match SchedulableField.ParameterId.Value against (long)BuiltInParameter (step 3); for shared or project parameters compare against the parameter element's Id.

pitfalls.symptom: GetCellText returns empty strings, or the table has no body rows.
pitfalls.cause: The schedule was read before regeneration, or from the Header section instead of Body.
pitfalls.fix: doc.Regenerate() after editing the definition and read SectionType.Body (step 5).

pitfalls.cause: Not every category is schedulable (e.g. lines, some annotation categories).
